name: Matbench v0.1 mp_gap
description: Predict the band gap of a crystal in eV, as calculated by density functional theory (PBE functional) from its crystal structure (Matbench v0.1 task mp_gap, 106113 samples). The evaluation uses the five official folds: for every fold the candidate is called once, in a separate process, with the other four folds and their target values as training data, and must predict the held-out fold within 600 seconds.
contract: fit_predict(train_inputs, train_targets, test_inputs, info) -> list of len(test_inputs) numbers. Every input is a dict with the keys lattice (the three lattice vectors in angstrom, a 3 x 3 list), species (the element symbol of every site) and frac_coords (the fractional coordinates of every site). info has task, input_type, target, unit, fold, n_train and n_test. Score: mean over the five folds of the held-out mean absolute error, minimized.
notes: Leaderboard best 0.1559 MAE (coGN), snapshot of matbench.materialsproject.org read 2026-11-03, date unknown.
matbench_mp_gap.json.gz from ml.materialsproject.org, folds from the official validation file
Predicts the PBE band gap (eV) of 106,113 Materials Project crystals from their structure, scored by mean absolute error over the five official folds.
Leaders are graph neural networks and tuned ensembles; the leaderboard snapshot has no date.
Regression MAE averaged over the five official folds.
This task has 106k-133k structures: featurising them is slow, so a candidate must be efficient; the seed uses a cheap feature set.
One evaluation of the starting program took 170 s in the run of 2026-11-11, more than the arena's default limit of 120 s: raise AR_EVAL_TIMEOUT for this task.

science_relevance.scientific_problem: Predict the DFT (PBE) band gap in eV of an inorganic crystal from its structure.
science_relevance.importance_rationale: The band gap decides whether a material is a metal, semiconductor or insulator and so its use in electronics and photovoltaics; DFT gaps are costly for large screens, so learned predictors prioritise candidates.

papers.title: Crystal Graph Convolutional Neural Networks for an Accurate and Interpretable Prediction of Material Properties
papers.task_relation: The paper's targets include the DFT band gap of Materials Project crystals; the task predicts the PBE gap on the Matbench subset with free choice of model.
papers.primary_goal: Learn crystal properties directly from the atomic connections of a structure, with a graph neural network trained on Materials Project DFT data (eight properties).
